turn_prompts: Generate a reproducible task Dockerfile from the approved task design. The frozen environment_policy input is the task contract: decode its canonical JSON and use environment_policy.base_image exactly, unchanged, in every FROM instruction. Do not use tag-only, digest-only, ARG-expanded, substituted, or additional base images. COPY/ADD --from may reference only an earlier local build-stage alias or numeric index; RUN --mount=from may reference only an earlier local build-stage alias. Never use an image or named external context. Do not use ONBUILD or Dockerfile parser directives. Produce only the required structured artifact.
